used_propositions: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and the Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change during that rebrand.
Registry record HRB 88421 is registered to Oakfield Logistik GmbH in Germany with active status.
Billing records bill the counterparty under the name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
support_claim: Billing and registry referents both name Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and identity-establishing evidence ties that legal name to HRB 88421 through registry records and an unchanged register number across rebrand.
